evals.name: implement-feature-request
evals.prompt: I want to add a /health endpoint to our FastAPI service that returns 200 OK with `{"status": "ok"}`. The service is in src/api/main.py. We use pytest. Can you implement this end-to-end with tests first?
evals.expected_output: Agent follows dev-workflow: explores existing routes, writes a failing pytest test that hits /health, adds the route, confirms test passes, produces a tidy commit-ready diff with no scope creep. Should_trigger: true.

evals.name: start-new-project
evals.prompt: I'm starting a brand-new Python CLI tool from scratch. Empty directory. I want it set up for use with Claude Code and Cursor with AGENTS.md, a pyproject.toml using uv, and an ISSUES.md tracker. Where do I start?
evals.expected_output: Agent recognizes this is project-init territory, NOT dev-workflow. dev-workflow should not trigger for empty-directory / scaffold-from-scratch requests. Should_trigger: false — project-init is the correct skill.

evals.name: debug-failing-test
evals.prompt: Our test_auth_token_refresh test started failing on CI this morning after someone merged a refactor to the JWT module. It passes locally for me but fails on CI with a cryptic 'invalid signature' error. Can you help me figure out what's going on and fix it?
evals.expected_output: Agent routes the bug to systematic debugging (superpowers:systematic-debugging where installed, otherwise references/bugfix.md): reproduces the failure, identifies root cause via the commit history, writes a regression test, fixes minimally, and confirms the full suite passes. Should_trigger: true.

evals.name: docs-only-edit-should-not-trigger
evals.prompt: I'm rewriting the architecture section of docs/design.md in my Lean formalization repo to match the new module layout. No Lean sources change. Can you help me restructure it?
evals.expected_output: Agent does NOT load dev-workflow. The deliverable is prose, not running code, so the five-phase code workflow does not apply: no branch cut by reflex, no test-first step, no CHANGELOG checklist. Agent edits the document directly. Should_trigger: false.

evals.name: respect-repo-branch-policy
evals.prompt: Fix the off-by-one in src/pager.py:88. Note our AGENTS.md says this repo is single-contributor and commits go straight to main.
evals.expected_output: Agent follows the repo's stated branch policy and works on main rather than cutting feature/<name>. Agent also skips the CHANGELOG step if the repo has no CHANGELOG.md instead of creating one. Should_trigger: true.
